changeSet.sql:
UPDATE cbam_subinstallation_migration m SET migration_status = 'FAILED', error_message = 'Source value not found in completed or in-progress permit' WHERE m.migration_status = 'PENDING'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permit p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( p.data #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) AS si(elem) WHERE p.account_id = m.account_id AND si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' = m.source_value )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM request r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( r.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) AS si(elem) WHERE r.account_id = m.account_id AND r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND r.type IN ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) AND si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' = m.source_value )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM request r JOIN request_task rt ON rt.request_id = r.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( rt.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) AS si(elem) WHERE r.account_id = m.account_id AND r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND r.type IN ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_A', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) AND si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' = m.source_value );

UPDATE permit p SET data = jsonb_set( p.data, '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg( CASE WHEN migration.target_value IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_set( si.elem, '{subInstallationType}', to_jsonb(migration.target_value::text), false ) ELSE si.elem END ORDER BY si.ord ) FROM jsonb_array_elements( p.data #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) WITH ORDINALITY AS si(elem, ord) LEFT JOIN cbam_subinstallation_migration migration ON migration.account_id = p.account_id AND migration.source_value = si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' AND migration.migration_status = 'PENDING' ), false ) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cbam_subinstallation_migration migration CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( p.data #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) AS si(elem) WHERE migration.account_id = p.account_id AND migration.migration_status = 'PENDING' AND migration.source_value = si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' );

UPDATE permit p SET data = jsonb_set( p.data, '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,methodTask,connections}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg( CASE WHEN jsonb_exists( connection.elem, 'subInstallations' ) THEN jsonb_set( connection.elem, '{subInstallations}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg( to_jsonb( COALESCE( migration.target_value, sub_type.value )::text ) ORDER BY sub_type.ord ) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( connection.elem -> 'subInstallations' ) WITH ORDINALITY AS sub_type(value, ord) LEFT JOIN cbam_subinstallation_migration migration ON migration.account_id = p.account_id AND migration.source_value = sub_type.value AND migration.migration_status = 'PENDING' ), false ) ELSE connection.elem END ORDER BY connection.ord ) FROM jsonb_array_elements( p.data #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,methodTask,connections}' ) WITH ORDINALITY AS connection(elem, ord) ), false ) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements( p.data #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,methodTask,connections}' ) AS connection(elem) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text( connection.elem -> 'subInstallations' ) AS sub_type(value) JOIN cbam_subinstallation_migration migration ON migration.account_id = p.account_id AND migration.source_value = sub_type.value AND migration.migration_status = 'PENDING' );

UPDATE request r SET payload = jsonb_set( r.payload, '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg( CASE WHEN migration.target_value IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_set( si.elem, '{subInstallationType}', to_jsonb(migration.target_value::text), false ) ELSE si.elem END ORDER BY si.ord ) FROM jsonb_array_elements( r.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) WITH ORDINALITY AS si(elem, ord) LEFT JOIN cbam_subinstallation_migration migration ON migration.account_id = r.account_id AND migration.source_value = si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' AND migration.migration_status = 'PENDING' ), false ) WHERE r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND r.type IN ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cbam_subinstallation_migration migration CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( r.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) AS si(elem) WHERE migration.account_id = r.account_id AND migration.migration_status = 'PENDING' AND migration.source_value = si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' );

UPDATE request r SET payload = jsonb_set( r.payload, '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,methodTask,connections}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg( CASE WHEN jsonb_exists( connection.elem, 'subInstallations' ) THEN jsonb_set( connection.elem, '{subInstallations}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg( to_jsonb( COALESCE( migration.target_value, sub_type.value )::text ) ORDER BY sub_type.ord ) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( connection.elem -> 'subInstallations' ) WITH ORDINALITY AS sub_type(value, ord) LEFT JOIN cbam_subinstallation_migration migration ON migration.account_id = r.account_id AND migration.source_value = sub_type.value AND migration.migration_status = 'PENDING' ), false ) ELSE connection.elem END ORDER BY connection.ord ) FROM jsonb_array_elements( r.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,methodTask,connections}' ) WITH ORDINALITY AS connection(elem, ord) ), false ) WHERE r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND r.type IN ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements( r.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,methodTask,connections}' ) AS connection(elem) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text( connection.elem -> 'subInstallations' ) AS sub_type(value) JOIN cbam_subinstallation_migration migration ON migration.account_id = r.account_id AND migration.source_value = sub_type.value AND migration.migration_status = 'PENDING' );

UPDATE request_task rt SET payload = jsonb_set( rt.payload, '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg( CASE WHEN migration.target_value IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_set( si.elem, '{subInstallationType}', to_jsonb(migration.target_value::text), false ) ELSE si.elem END ORDER BY si.ord ) FROM jsonb_array_elements( rt.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) WITH ORDINALITY AS si(elem, ord) LEFT JOIN cbam_subinstallation_migration migration ON migration.account_id = r.account_id AND migration.source_value = si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' AND migration.migration_status = 'PENDING' ), false ) FROM request r WHERE r.id = rt.request_id AND r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND r.type IN ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_A', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cbam_subinstallation_migration migration CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( rt.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) AS si(elem) WHERE migration.account_id = r.account_id AND migration.migration_status = 'PENDING' AND migration.source_value = si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' );

UPDATE request_task rt SET payload = jsonb_set( rt.payload, '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,methodTask,connections}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg( CASE WHEN jsonb_exists( connection.elem, 'subInstallations' ) THEN jsonb_set( connection.elem, '{subInstallations}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg( to_jsonb( COALESCE( migration.target_value, sub_type.value )::text ) ORDER BY sub_type.ord ) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( connection.elem -> 'subInstallations' ) WITH ORDINALITY AS sub_type(value, ord) LEFT JOIN cbam_subinstallation_migration migration ON migration.account_id = r.account_id AND migration.source_value = sub_type.value AND migration.migration_status = 'PENDING' ), false ) ELSE connection.elem END ORDER BY connection.ord ) FROM jsonb_array_elements( rt.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,methodTask,connections}' ) WITH ORDINALITY AS connection(elem, ord) ), false ) FROM request r WHERE r.id = rt.request_id AND r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND r.type IN ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_A', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements( rt.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,methodTask,connections}' ) AS connection(elem) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text( connection.elem -> 'subInstallations' ) AS sub_type(value) JOIN cbam_subinstallation_migration migration ON migration.account_id = r.account_id AND migration.source_value = sub_type.value AND migration.migration_status = 'PENDING' );

UPDATE cbam_subinstallation_migration m SET migration_status = 'COMPLETED', migrated_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_message = NULL WHERE m.migration_status = 'PENDING'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permit p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( p.data #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) AS si(elem) WHERE p.account_id = m.account_id AND si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' = m.source_value )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permit p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( p.data #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,methodTask,connections}' ) AS connection(elem) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text( connection.elem -> 'subInstallations' ) AS sub_type(value) WHERE p.account_id = m.account_id AND sub_type.value = m.source_value )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM request r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( r.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) AS si(elem) WHERE r.account_id = m.account_id AND r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND r.type IN ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) AND si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' = m.source_value )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM request r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( r.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,methodTask,connections}' ) AS connection(elem) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text( connection.elem -> 'subInstallations' ) AS sub_type(value) WHERE r.account_id = m.account_id AND r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND r.type IN ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) AND sub_type.value = m.source_value )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM request r JOIN request_task rt ON rt.request_id = r.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( rt.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) AS si(elem) WHERE r.account_id = m.account_id AND r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND r.type IN ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_A', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) AND si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' = m.source_value )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM request r JOIN request_task rt ON rt.request_id = r.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( rt.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,methodTask,connections}' ) AS connection(elem) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text( connection.elem -> 'subInstallations' ) AS sub_type(value) WHERE r.account_id = m.account_id AND r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND r.type IN ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_A', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) AND sub_type.value = m.source_value )
AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permit p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( p.data #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) AS si(elem) WHERE p.account_id = m.account_id AND si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' = m.target_value )
OR
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM request r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( r.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) AS si(elem) WHERE r.account_id = m.account_id AND r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND r.type IN ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) AND si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' = m.target_value )
OR
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM request r JOIN request_task rt ON rt.request_id = r.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( rt.payload #> '{permit,monitoringMethodologyPlans,digitizedPlan,subInstallations}' ) AS si(elem) WHERE r.account_id = m.account_id AND r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND r.type IN ( 'PERMIT_ISSUANCE', 'PERMIT_VARIATION', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_A', 'PERMIT_TRANSFER_B' ) AND si.elem ->> 'subInstallationType' = m.target_value ) );
UPDATE cbam_subinstallation_migration SET migration_status = 'FAILED', error_message = 'Migration verification failed' WHERE migration_status = 'PENDING';
